description: Header file defining the PacingSender class, which implements a pacing algorithm on top of a send algorithm for QUIC congestion control. It manages pacing rate, burst tokens, and timing for packet sending.
external_methods: void OnCongestionEvent(bool rtt_updated, QuicByteCount bytes_in_flight, QuicTime event_time, const AckedPacketVector& acked_packets, const LostPacketVector& lost_packets, QuicPacketCount num_ect, QuicPacketCount num_ce)
void OnPacketSent(QuicTime sent_time, QuicByteCount bytes_in_flight, QuicPacketNumber packet_number, QuicByteCount bytes, HasRetransmittableData has_retransmittable_data)
QuicTime::Delta TimeUntilSend(QuicTime now, QuicByteCount bytes_in_flight) const

classes.name: PacingSender
classes.description: Implements a pacing algorithm for sending packets in QUIC, managing pacing rate, burst tokens, and timing to optimize packet transmission and avoid congestion.

methods.name: set_sender
methods.description: Sets the underlying send algorithm; does not take ownership.

methods.name: set_alarm_granularity
methods.description: Sets the granularity of the alarm for pacing.

methods.name: max_pacing_rate
methods.description: Returns the current maximum pacing rate.

methods.name: OnCongestionEvent
methods.description: Handles congestion events, updating pacing based on network conditions.

methods.name: OnPacketSent
methods.description: Called when a packet is sent, updates pacing state.

methods.name: OnApplicationLimited
methods.description: Indicates that the application is throttling sending, affecting pacing.

methods.name: SetBurstTokens
methods.description: Sets the number of burst tokens for packet sending.

methods.name: TimeUntilSend
methods.description: Calculates time remaining until next packet can be sent.

methods.name: PacingRate
methods.description: Returns the current pacing rate based on bytes in flight.

methods.name: GetNextReleaseTime
methods.description: Returns the next scheduled packet release time and whether burst is allowed.

methods.name: lumpy_tokens
methods.description: Returns the number of lumpy tokens.
